claims.evidence: Witness report shows a propane/LPG-style cylinder but no readable capacity/size marking was reported.
Witness report does not include any import/tokunbo documentation or markings that confirm origin.

risks.risk: Unknown fill level (empty vs filled) affects immediate value and buyer risk
risks.proof: A clear shot of the cylinder gauge/indicator (if any) or a photo showing the tare/weight marking and current weight (weighing on a scale).
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: treated as empty/unknown fill until weight/fill is confirmed.

risks.risk: Possible leak at valve/regulator area (no leak test shown; no protective cap visible)
risks.proof: A short video of a leak test: apply soapy water to valve/regulator joints and show no bubbles, plus a tightness check of the knob/fittings.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven safe: treated as potentially leaking/needs service.

risks.risk: Valve seals/regulator condition unknown (witness only saw fittings; no functional test)
risks.proof: A clip showing regulator/valve operation (turn on/off) and stable flow without hissing, plus close-up of seal condition.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: valve/regulator may need replacement or servicing.

risks.proof: Clear photos of inspection/expiry stamps and certification markings on the cylinder body/neck.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: certification not confirmed, so assume it may be rejected or require re-qualification.

risks.risk: Metal integrity not fully assessed (heavy surface rust reported; dents/cracks/thinning not shown)
risks.proof: A close-up inspection video under strong light showing no dents/cracks/thinning, including the bottom/side cut-out/vent area.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: only surface rust is visible, but integrity is not guaranteed—assume higher risk.

risks.risk: Compatibility/safety of any included hose/regulator unknown (hose/regulator not shown)
risks.proof: If any accessories are included, provide clear photos of hose/regulator model and fittings, and show they match the cylinder valve thread/type.
risks.if_unproven: Price as cylinder-only with no guaranteed compatible accessories.

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the cylinder capacity/size marking (to confirm the 20kg claim).
Send photos of all inspection/expiry/certification stamps on the cylinder neck/body.
Send a short video leak test at the valve/regulator joints using soapy water (no bubbles).
Send a close-up of the valve seals/regulator area and a clip showing the valve/regulator operation (no hissing).
Send a photo of the cylinder weight markings and, if possible, a scale weighing to confirm fill level.
If any hose/regulator is included, send clear photos showing model/type and fittings compatibility.
response.reason: The witness can identify it as a propane/LPG-style gas cylinder and describe visible wear (heavy rust, no protective cap). However, key safety/value factors (fill level, leak status, certification, and exact capacity) are not shown, so it should be priced at the worst case until the requested proof is provided.
